children: Medtronic corrected the guaranteed delivery expiration time in the MiniMed exchange offer prospectus to 5:00 p.m. NYC on the second NYSE trading day.
Medtronic commenced an exchange offer of up to 225,361,295 MiniMed shares for outstanding Medtronic ordinary shares.
Discovered typographical error: prospectus incorrectly stated guaranteed delivery expired at 12:00 midnight on the second NYSE trading day.
Corrected procedure: guaranteed delivery period expires at 5:00 p.m. New York City time on the second NYSE trading day after execution.
Medtronic filed the Form 8-K to amend the Prospectus and directs investors to the Prospectus, Registration Statement and Schedule TO for full details.
